canonical_equations: Sort valid x. While n>=4 select first minimum RN32(x[j+ceil(n/2)-1]-x[j]); recurse. n1 canonical x; n2 correctly rounded exact mean; n3 closest-pair correctly rounded mean, equal gaps middle x.
input_contract: binary32-hex samples[B,N],valid[B,N] uint0/1;B1..128,N1..256,B*N*N<=2097152;finite values and executed intermediates.
output_contract: B x [u32 status,valid_count,f32 mode,low,high,width,u32 terminal_count,halving_rounds,sorted_start]; status1 empty with other fields0. No uncertainty is inferred from terminal width.
result_contract: B x [u32 status,valid_count,f32 mode,low,high,width,u32 terminal_count,halving_rounds,sorted_start]; status1 empty with other fields0. No uncertainty is inferred from terminal width.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
